maddeler.e:
عببت (form I)
# عَبَبْتُ (ʕababtu) /ʕa.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of عَبَّ (ʕabba)
# عَبَبْتَ (ʕababta) /ʕa.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of عَبَّ (ʕabba)
# عَبَبْتِ (ʕababti) /ʕa.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of عَبَّ (ʕabba)
# عُبِبْتُ (ʕubibtu) /ʕu.bib.tu/: first-person singular past passive of عَبَّ (ʕabba)
# عُبِبْتَ (ʕubibta) /ʕu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
